changes: First release in Modwerk for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1: STRING, a Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine.
Four exciters (BOW, HIT, NOISE, PLUCK) and STIFF, POS, SOFT, TONE and DECAY controls; values are saved, p-lockable and LFO destinations.
Same code as the author's v0.8.0 release; Modwerk only repackaged it.
Known issue: with more than four STRING tracks playing, the UI lags; not yet tested on hardware on OS 1.53.
